verdict.rationale: The evidence documents bill capture, batch bill payment and duplicate-bill detection, plus generic performance dashboards and KPIs. None of it mentions an aged payables report, vendor or supplier balance views, or as-of-date reporting. AP aging is a fair axis for accounting software, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
